Zero-Impact Breach Prevention
Mitiga cloud security managed services
Mitiga’s cloud managed services provide 24/7 M-CDR, managed threat hunting, and managed incident response to eliminate breach impact across Cloud and SaaS.
Detect, Verify, & Respond 365/24/7
Managed Cloud Detection and Response (M-CDR)
Always-on defense for your SaaS, Cloud, AI, and Identity
‍
Prevention-based CNAPPs and CSPMs focus on cloud misconfigurations. Mitiga goes beyond misconfigurations to real-time detection of threats, anomalies, and behavioral-based indicators of attack that stem from dangerous user activities across cloud, Saas, AI, and identities.
Mitiga’s
Cloud Security Managed Services
deliver
Zero-Impact Breach Prevention
, combining:
24/7 Managed Detection and Response of our platform
Expert-led threat hunting
Rapid cloud and SaaS incident response
Our teams monitor continuously, correlate activity across platforms, and eliminate noise. When intrusions occur, we contain them mid-flight and ensure there’s no business impact.
ON THE HUNT
Managed Threat Hunting
Stay ahead of hidden threats in your SaaS, Cloud, and AI environments.
Automated alerts miss the subtle movements attackers rely on.
Mitiga’s Cloud Managed Threat Hunting
program pairs advanced analytics with seasoned investigators to uncover activity that other tools overlook.
Continuous hunts across cloud, SaaS, identities, and AI
Proprietary intelligence combined with deep forensic data
Rapid cloud and SaaS findings with remediation guidance and posture improvements
Instead of waiting for alerts, you take the fight to attackers, reducing dwell time and closing gaps before they’re exploited.

Our approach goes beyond cleanup. We shut down active threats, limit damage, and harden your defenses for the future.
FAQs
Mitiga Cloud Security Managed Services
What are Mitiga’s managed cloud detection and response services?
Specialized services that handle detection, investigation, and response across cloud, SaaS, Identities, and AI. Mitiga delivers Zero-Impact Breach Prevention with Managed-CDR, Managed Threat Hunting, and Managed IR
How do they help with alert fatigue?
We enrich and correlate signals, reducing false positives so analysts see only high-fidelity alerts. Our team will further triage and document alerts, extending the capabilities of your organization.
Are these services suited for global enterprises and fast-growing companies?
Yes. Our managed services support lean teams and large SOCs alike, with scalable coverage around the world.
How does Mitiga reduce investigation time?
The Mitiga platform stores and normalizes 1,000 days of forensic data, correlating identities to entities in advance. Our investigation automation delivers attack timelines in minutes.
Can Mitiga detect insider threats?
Yes. We analyze user activity, privilege changes, and SaaS access to detect risky or abnormal behavior. Attackers today no longer break in, they login, which means that all of our detections work for external and internal threats alike.
Do these services support hybrid environments?
Yes. While optimized for SaaS and Cloud, we integrate with on-prem systems for unified visibility and response.
